mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a supply-driven inflation scare that will pressure the Fed to tighten policy and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in payroll employment, if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a cyclical labor market peak that will presage an economic slowdown and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 300k in 1 month and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp
failure_condition: Leading economic indicators (e.g., ISM PMI) continue to expand at an accelerating pace, indicating the labor market signal is a false positive.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in housing starts, if not offset by a rise in retail sales, signals a demand-driven growth scare that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS does not rise > 5% YoY
failure_condition: Housing starts stabilize or rebound in the following month, indicating the initial drop was a temporary blip rather than the start of a sustained downtrend.

mechanism_narrative: A surprise rate hike by the Fed, not telegraphed in advance, signals a hawkish policy shift that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets adjust to the new reality.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 25bp at a scheduled FOMC meeting
failure_condition: Equity markets stabilize and rebound within 10 trading days, indicating the rate hike was already priced in or will have minimal economic impact.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a looming recession that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve steepens within 3 months, indicating the inversion was a false recession signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, if not accompanied by a rise in industrial production, signals a cost-push inflation scare that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM and INDPRO does not rise
failure_condition: Core inflation (excluding food and energy) remains stable, indicating the CPI spike was driven by transitory factors rather than a sustained inflationary impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate, if accompanied by a rise in average hourly earnings, signals a wage-price spiral that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy to combat inflation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 0.3pp in 3 months and AHETPI rises > 3% YoY
failure_condition: The Fed signals a willingness to tolerate higher inflation and avoids aggressive rate hikes, indicating the wage-price spiral will not trigger a policy tightening cycle.
